description: This file defines the DictionaryProvider class, an Android ContentProvider that manages access to a dictionary database for search suggestions, word lookups, and related functionalities within an Android application.

classes.name: DictionaryProvider
classes.description: An Android ContentProvider that interfaces with DictionaryDatabase to serve search suggestions, definitions, and shortcut shortcuts for the searchable dictionary app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the DictionaryDatabase instance when the provider is created.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles search and suggestion queries based on the URI pattern, routing them to the appropriate internal methods.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Returns a Cursor with word suggestions matching the input query.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns a Cursor with dictionary entries matching the search query.

methods.name: getWord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific word and its definition given a URI with the word's ID.

methods.name: refreshShortcut
methods.description: Refreshes shortcut data based on URI, if shortcuts are used.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for different URI patterns handled by the Provider.
